t: eSTART
s: The Electronic Secure Title and Registration Transformation (eSTART) Coalition is a united group of leading automotive organizations committed to modernizing and streamlining automotive title and registration processes. eSTART focuses on advocating for the implementation of efficient technology solutions to replace the paper-dependent systems currently used by DMVs.

t: eSTART Hits Milestone as It Pushes for Digital Titles
s: September 20, 2024 - The push to bring more digital power and efficiency to automotive titles and registrations has hit a milestone as one of the groups behind that effort pulls in more industry leaders. The Electronic Secure Title and Registration Transformation (eSTART) Coalition says it has accepted its 100th member — up from the 18 founding organizations that supported the group just about six months ago.
